articles.title: This 240W Thunderbolt 4 cable just hit a new low price
articles.description: NEW LOWEST PRICE Ugreen 240W Thunderbolt 4 Cable We know you probably have a million cables everywhere scattered around your house, but you could always use another, especially since this Ugreen USB-C Thunderbolt 4 cable is down to $13.26 at Amazon, a 37 percent discount from its MSRP. That’s a brand new historical low price, just in time for the Black Friday shopping season. With up to 240W of power delivery, this TB4 cable handles charging, fast file transfers, and video output effortlessly. It’s robust enough to manage the heavy-duty connection between your laptop and a high-res monitor with ease. Thanks to USB Power Delivery 3.1 support, it serves as a powerful charging cord. Ugreen says it can charge a 16-inch MacBook Pro to 50 percent in 30 minutes, assuming you’re the charger you’re using can deliver that speed. It also works with lower-power gear requiring 140W, 100W, or 65W. Data transfers are lightning fast, too. At up to 40Gbps, you can move a 20GB 4K movie in about three seconds. That saves a lot of time, especially when you’re backing up files to an external SSD. It also lets you connect your laptop to an 8K monitor at 60Hz. The cable works with Thunderbolt 4 and Thunderbolt 3 ports, and it’s backward compatible with USB4, USB 3.2, USB 3.1, and USB 3.0. Snatch one of these super-fast Ugreen cables for $13.26 while this deal is still live at Amazon.
